context: Interactive 3-level sunburst chart (Product Taxonomy Explorer) with 6 departments, ~24 categories, and 136 leaf products. Features radial brushing on the outer ring, click-to-zoom on inner rings, breadcrumb navigation, and a sidebar with live stats and legend.
first_impression: Visually organized and readable at the department and category levels, though the outer product ring is densely packed with truncated labels that are largely illegible at full zoom.
what_works: Depth-adjusted color lightness (lighter = deeper level) elegantly encodes hierarchy within each department's hue family without adding more colors; the sidebar stats, breadcrumb trail, and 6-item legend form a coherent peripheral context that doesn't compete with the main chart.
what_doesnt: The outer ring's 136 product segments are too narrow to read at the root view, creating a decorative rather than informative outer band — the zoom interaction mitigates this but the unzoomed state still presents a density problem; animation quality across ~150 simultaneously moving nodes during zoom cannot be assessed from the static screenshot.
